data.name: Balkrushna
data.gender_notes: Balkrushna is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Balkrushna is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bal' meaning strength and 'Krushna' meaning black or dark. It is the name of Lord Vishnu, who is also known as Balaji or Balakrishna, symbolizing divine strength and protection. The name Balkrushna carries the meaning “God of Strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Balkrushna usually hope their child will grow to embody god of strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Balkrushna belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balkrushna total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_sanskrit.name: बालकृष्ण
in_sanskrit.meaning: बाल (bāla) - child, कृष्ण (kṛṣṇa) - dark, black, and God Krishna
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bāla (child) and Kṛṣṇa (dark, black, and God Krishna) make the name Balkrushna. Bāla refers to the child form of Lord Krishna, while Kṛṣṇa symbolizes the divine and powerful aspect of the deity.

data.cultural_impact: Balkrushna is a popular name in the Hindu community, especially in regions like Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana in India. The name carries a rich cultural heritage and is associated with devotion towards Lord Vishnu. It is commonly used as a personal name, and people named Balkrushna are often considered to be blessed and protected by the deity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Balkrushna holds spiritual significance as it is the name of Lord Vishnu, who is worshipped as a source of strength, protection, and preservation. The name signifies the belief in divine intervention in one's life and the recognition of the power of the Almighty to provide strength and resilience in times of need. It is a reminder of the faith and hope that one can place in the divine, seeking His blessings and guidance in every aspect of life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Balkrushna signifies the one who crushes the 'Bala' or inner weaknesses and embodies strength and courage. It is a reminder to overcome inner struggles and face challenges with determination.

historical_references.reference: Balkrishna was a prominent Maratha warrior and general during the reign of Chhatrapati Shahuji Maharaj (1707–1749). He was instrumental in the Battle of Pavan Khind and was awarded the title of 'Mastani Maharaj' for his bravery.

Balkrishna was also a significant leader in the Satara Kingdom during the late 18th century. He played a crucial role in the defense of the kingdom against the British East India Company and is remembered for his military strategies and leadership.
